brief: A balcony bed with a pipe run feeding water, two soil-filled bins and a drawer underneath for seed packets.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;half-s + piece:1,0,0;half-n base level 0 with pieces level 1 above; bins on level 1
run:run-1 at 0,0 and run:run-2 at 1,0, level 0 pipe runs under the bed
bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-half-s-full and bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-half-n-full, both fillSoil + planted (prop:1 lettuce-butterhead-seedling, prop:2 basil-seedling)
drawer:0#0,0#cut at 0,0 level 0 under the bins, set open for visibility; no seed-packet prop exists in catalog (packet/card searches return 0), so drawer left open and empty for user's own packets

finish.summary: Compact two-cell balcony bed: two half bases below joined by connector with drawer underneath (left open), two half bases above carrying two soil-filled bins planted with lettuce and basil seedlings, with a pipe run under each cell. House rules capOpenFaces + lockJoints applied, check_build clear.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: 2 runs IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
